help.sum: Sculpt sizes run from 2XS to 3XL. See the size guide on sculptactivewear.com for the measurements of each style; product pages list the model's height and the size she wears.

Returns Policy
Returns must be received within 14 days of delivery or collection. To be eligible for a refund or exchange, items must be:
Unworn, unwashed and free from odours, stains, make-up, fake tan and pet hair.
Returned in their original plastic packaging with swing tags attached.
Accompanied by the original packing slip.
Bodysuits must have their original hygiene strip intact.
For hygiene reasons, underwear cannot be returned, and opened socks are non-returnable.
Returns that are damaged, altered, tampered with or do not meet these conditions may be rejected and returned to you. You will receive an email explaining the reason, with photographic evidence and tracking details.
How to Return an Order
Shipped Orders
Return your order through our online returns portal. UK customers can purchase a Royal Mail returns label for £3.99, deducted from the refund. You can print the label or request a QR code through the Royal Mail returns portal.

Delivery Information
All orders are shipped with Royal Mail and processed Monday to Friday, excluding UK bank holidays. Orders placed before 2pm are dispatched the same working day.
UK Delivery
Next Working Day Delivery: £4.99 (estimated 1–2 working days).
Two-Day Delivery: £3.99 (estimated 2–3 working days).
Free Two-Day Delivery on orders over £75.
International Delivery
We ship to almost 93% of the world: Europe £8.49, North America £13.99, Far East & Australasia £11.99 (3–5 working days).
Click & Collect
Collect from Sculpt Activewear HQ, Tameside Business Park, Denton, Manchester M34 3QS once you receive your collection email. Mon & Fri 10am–6pm, Tue–Thu 10am–5pm.

Refer a friend and you both get £10 worth of points.
